comparisons.peer_summary: All Other operating loss was $4.2 billion in 2024 and $4.4 billion in 2023, primarily consisting of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and stock-based compensation expense.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD discuss unallocated or 'All Other' operating expenses that include amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and stock-based compensation. AVGO reports a 192% increase in these unallocated expenses driven by the VMware Merger and higher grant-date fair values of equity awards (avgo_2024_7_P057_S002, avgo_2024_7_P057_S004). AMD reports an 'All Other' operating loss of $4.2 billion, primarily consisting of $2.4 billion in amortization and $1.4 billion in stock-based compensation (amd_2024_7_P042_S001). While both companies attribute similar non-operating costs to stock-based compensation and amortization, AVGO highlights a massive percentage increase due to a specific large merger, whereas AMD presents a large absolute loss figure that slightly decreased from the prior year.

sentences.text: Unallocated expenses include amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets; stock-based compensation expense; restructuring and other charges; acquisition-related costs; and other costs that are not used in evaluating the results of, or in allocating resources to, our segments.

Unallocated expenses increased 192% in fiscal year 2024, compared to the prior fiscal year, primarily due to higher amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense and restructuring and other charges.
The increase in stock-based compensation expense was also due to annual employee equity awards granted at higher grant-date fair values.
All Other operating loss of $4.2 billion in 2024 primarily consisted of $2.4 billion of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and $1.4 billion of stock-based compensation expense.
